title: Office Coordinator
description:
Temporary Receptionist / Office Coordinator

Charlotte, NC (Onsite)

1–2 Month Contract

Schedule

  • Monday–Thursday
  • 8:30 AM – 4:00 PM
  • Some schedule flexibility available for the right candidate

Position Overview

A respected Charlotte investment firm is seeking a professional, customer-focused Temporary Receptionist to support daily office operations during a short-term coverage assignment. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating a welcoming office environment, providing exceptional customer service, and handling a variety of administrative and facilities-related responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Welcome clients and visitors, escort guests to conference rooms, and provide a polished first impression.
  • Offer beverages to guests and prepare conference rooms before and after meetings.
  • Maintain kitchen, break room, and common areas by keeping them clean, organized, and fully stocked.
  • Monitor inventory levels for office supplies, snacks, and beverages and communicate replenishment needs.
  • Receive, sort, scan, and distribute incoming mail and deliveries.
  • Unpack office supply and snack shipments as they arrive.
  • Coordinate weekly UPS Store runs and other light errands as needed.
  • Lift and move cases of bottled water, soft drinks, and other office supplies.
  • Provide general administrative support to ensure smooth day-to-day office operations.

Qualifications

  • Previous receptionist, front desk, administrative assistant, hospitality, or office support experience preferred.
  • Professional appearance and excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Strong customer service mindset with the ability to create a welcoming environment.
  • Organized, dependable, and proactive with excellent attention to detail.
  • Comfortable performing light physical tasks, including lifting cases of beverages and unpacking deliveries.
  • Reliable transportation for occasional local UPS Store runs.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office and general office technology.

Ideal Candidate

We're looking for someone with a positive attitude who enjoys being the face of the office. The ideal candidate is polished, dependable, enjoys interacting with people, takes pride in maintaining an organized workspace, and is willing to jump in wherever needed to support the team.

Recruiter Notes

  • Contract Length: 1–2 months
  • Onsite: Monday–Thursday
  • Great opportunity for someone between roles, returning to the workforce, a retiree seeking temporary work, or an experienced receptionist looking for short-term employment.
  • Looking for immediate availability.

title: AI Product Manager
description:
Title - AI Product Manager
Duration - 6 month
Location- Charlotte, NC

PRIMARY SKILLS:
• Intermediate to advanced AI competency and practical adoption of AI tools in design
• SharePoint expertise for collaboration, content management
• Minimum of 5+ Years of hands-on experience in experience design e.g. UX/UI

Nice to Have Skills:
• 5+ Years Product Management Experience
•Financial and/or Merchant Services background
• UX Web Design Experience
• Self sufficient and proactive with innovative ideas and solutions
• Proven Ability of Time Management and advanced stakeholder Communication abilities
• Collaborative

Superior project management, stakeholder management and strong technical competencies to work with AI prompts/MS Copilot and SharePoint UX/UI design.

Job Description:
We're seeking a highly organized contractor to support the development of our AI-powered sales enablement platform. This person will partner with subject matter experts across Product, Sales, Marketing, Pricing, Operations and more to create and maintain AI prompts and related source materials to form a library of uses cases for the platform.

Responsibilities
- Manage multiple AI content projects simultaneously
- Interview subject experts to gather source materials and identify documentation gaps
- Organize and integrate content for effective AI grounding and user experience
- Identify opportunities for new AI prompts and use cases across the business

Qualifications
- Experience working with or creating AI prompts, workflows, or knowledge bases
- Heavy usage of AI tools or platforms (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar) and an understanding of how to evaluate output quality
- Strong project management and stakeholder management skills
- Excellent communication, interviewing, and organizational abilities
- Self-starter with the ability to work independently and influence across teams

Preferred
- Experience in product management, knowledge management, enablement, business analysis, or content strategy
- Familiarity with SharePoint and UX/UI principles
- Financial services or Merchant services experience

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Job Title: Customer Service Representative
Job Location: Kent WA
Contract Duration: 06 Months Contract (With Higher Possibility of Extension or Conversion)
Pay Rate: $18.00/hr on W2
Shift Details: Our operating days are Monday-Saturday and Sunday the site is closed. The operating hours are 05:00 am to 19:00am. The shift will be 8.5 hours. between those operating days and hours.

*** Manager Comments on Role: Spanish Speaking is preferred. Need to have reliable commute and Flexibility for the shift. Please communicate business casual dress and closed shoes like training or tennis shoes.

As a Customer Service Representative, you will ensure that we deliver on our promise of outstanding service. You’ll work with customers, business partners and drivers to make sure we are meeting our commitments and delighting our customers at every step of the experience

What your day-to-day will look like:
• Assist customers and business partners via telephone and email
• Handle customer complaints in a calm, professional manner
• Diagnose, assess, and resolve problems or issues
• Monitor progress of delivery routes
• Scan haul-away pods and verify stamps
• Process changes or cancellations to delivery orders

What you’ll need to excel:
At a minimum, you’ll need:
• Experience with Microsoft Office programs such as MS Project, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
It’d be great if you also have:
• High school diploma or equivalent
• 1-year related experience preferably within a call center environment
• Strong customer service skills and the ability to satisfactorily resolve issues
• Solid ability to multitask with exceptional organizational skills
• Ability to thrive under pressure while delivering solutions that exceed customer expectations

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
About the Role:

Job Title: Customer Service Representative
Location: Passaic, NJ 07055 (Onsite)
Max Pay Rate: $18.50/hr
Schedule: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Friday, Saturday
Shift: 5:00 AM – 1:30 PM (Wednesday & Thursday Off)
Duration: 4 Months Contract

Please find the job description below. I’d love to schedule a quick call to go over the details and learn more about what you’re looking for in your next role. If this is not the right fit for what you are targeting right now we are also happy to pay a referral bonus if you have a former colleague in mind please feel free to pass this information along as well!

About the Role

We are seeking a Customer Service Representative to support daily operations in a fast-paced, logistics-driven environment. In this role, you will work closely with customers, business partners, and drivers to ensure smooth delivery operations and exceptional service.

This is a great opportunity for candidates with customer service or call center experience who enjoy problem-solving and working in a dynamic team environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist customers and partners via phone and email
  • Handle inquiries, complaints, and service issues professionally
  • Diagnose and resolve delivery or order-related problems
  • Monitor delivery routes and provide real-time updates
  • Process order changes, cancellations, and updates
  • Perform data entry and maintain accurate records
  • Support logistics operations including scanning and verification tasks

Required Qualifications

  • Experience using Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
  • Strong communication and customer service skills
  • Ability to multitask and stay organized in a fast-paced environment
  • Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications

  • 1+ year of customer service or call center experience
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Experience in logistics, dispatch, or delivery support (a plus)
  • Bilingual skills (highly preferred)
